family: The single total threshold-2 family defined in proof.md: L is the set of binary strings containing at least two 1s; for n>=0, f_n(x_1,...,x_n)=1 iff the sum of the x_i is at least 2, with the empty-witness polynomial-time verifier in proof.md. No per-length advice, padding, blocks, or witness input to circuits.
theorem: For this one total uniform polynomial-time family, hence in NP with empty witnesses, C_B2(f_n)>=2n-4 for every integer n>=0, so C_B2(f_n)>=2*n-o(n) at every sufficiently large integer length n=|x| in the full Li-Yang B2 model.
